name: Clash of Empires
author: Wololoader
description: Clash of Clans style attack mode (2 players: Attacker vs Defender). The whole map is visible. You have no village: pick troops with unit icons from the bottom deployment bar and click anywhere on the map to spawn them! Destroy the enemy village in the middle to load a brand-new random map at the next level. Lose all your units and it is over.

resources.name: Level
resources.description: Current level of Clash of Empires. Each level generates a new random map with a stronger village.

resources.name: Army Points
resources.description: Spend Army Points on the bottom troop bar: select a unit card and click on the map to deploy it.

resources.name: Clash of Empires save data
resources.description: Internal: lets a saved Clash of Empires game continue after loading.

game_modes.name: Clash of Empires
game_modes.description: Clash of Clans in Age of Empires! 2 players only (Player 1 Attacker with no village vs Player 2 Defender). Full map visible. Pick a unit from the bottom bar and click the map to deploy. Destroy the village to advance to a new random map!
